title: Public source admission and feasibility
schemas: source_access, source_object, study, publication_family, observation, parameter_evidence; evidence_profile v2
tracer: Original S001/S004/V201 object → study family → actual extracted observation → permissible role; no table admitted merely by citation.
work: resolve and cache objects; preserve access failures; curate units/denominators; choose evidence profile before ranking
assertions: public manifest rejects internal/unknown origins; figure predictions cannot enter observations; duplicate studies/shared controls retained as dependencies; absent numerical biology emits C-INCOMPLETE
failure_states: unknown access, no biological units, mixed analyte, empty public quantitative foundation
reviewers: data steward + pharmacometric and immunology source reviewers

title: Lead and upstream reconstruction
schemas: compound, formulation, model_asset, parameter_evidence; evidence_profile v2
tracer: Verified upstream equations/parameter table → explicit missing inputs → open replay/port plan
work: compare leads on recoverability not simulation results; recover source equations/assets; select canonical backend; establish exact/partial/new reuse category
assertions: unpublished/request-only dependency is blocked or removed transparently; chosen lead has complete identity; no false numerical parity
failure_states: inaccessible required asset, licence conflict, unresolved drug identity

title: Systemic exposure and independent evaluation
dependencies: E1 plus admitted independent PK role
tracer: Public PK study/dose/history → amount equations → predicted original-analyte scale → independent source error
work: implement PK/PBPK and parsimonious comparator; validate amount/event accounting; freeze and evaluate independent exposure object
assertions: amount/concentration and CL/F errors rejected; infusion/time-origin correct; no downstream tumour fit retunes fixed PK; evaluation is original-study independent
failure_states: mass imbalance, missing dose history, unresolvable independence

title: Public target/priming PD and recovery constraints
dependencies: E2 uncertainty interface plus public PD admission
tracer: Source exposure/withdrawal and assay → mapped state/likelihood → identifiable rate/amplitude set
work: implement minimal direct/delay/turnover candidates; distinguish endpoints from trajectories; profile recovery and remove unsupported hidden states
assertions: single endpoint cannot silently release unique recovery; carryover distinguished; qPCR/flow/WB scales not absolute counts; adverse response allowed
failure_states: unidentified parameter presented as measured, unsupported context transfer

title: Reduced QSP and functional constraints
dependencies: E3 interface plus public biological constraints
tracer: Qualified published target-specific/antibody endpoint → minimal killing terms → context-specific constraint set
work: implement tumour/immune/direct-toxicity separation and checkpoint observer; test unsupported mechanisms as hypotheses, not measurements
assertions: no immune cells means no immune killing; no blockade term from unqualified assay; no lymph-node culture trafficking; positivity/event limits hold
failure_states: mixed viability interpreted as tumour killing, incompatible assay/context, duplicated binding clearance

title: Public holdouts and prediction identifiability
tracer: Public holdout observation or evidence equivalence class → frozen predictions/profiles → metric or certificate
work: run fair baselines; assess structural/practical and contrast identifiability; independently evaluate available layers; freeze selected profile
assertions: mutating held-out outcomes leaves development unchanged; unknown training overlap is not independent; counterexamples fit actual constraints; no claimed proof from failed optimiser
failure_states: leakage, post-outcome endpoint switch, unjustified finite bounds

title: Ensembles, fixed schedules and robustness
schemas: population, vpop_target, scenario, dosing_event, run; evidence_profile v2
dependencies: E5 accepted uncertainty/contrast contract; no local data dependency
tracer: Public constraint/target → set or weighted ensemble → paired events → primary contrast/uncertainty
work: generate correctly typed ensemble; compare fixed primary and secondary schedules; optional optimisation held out from ensemble/structure checks
assertions: ESS and correlations reported; ensemble frequency not patient probability; equal amount not automatically equal AUC; no advantage from hidden lead-in/horizon; sampled extrema labelled
failure_states: unjustified weights/prevalence, dose imbalance, empty feasible set, false global robustness

title: Reproduction, manuscript and foundation release
dependencies: All core E0–E6 gates and selected complete profile
tracer: Every figure/claim → run hash → public observation/constraint → original study and actual N
work: replay clean environment; audit claims/privacy/rights; create evidence-linked figures; publish immutable foundation with no internal dependencies
assertions: whole core works with E_LAST/internal storage absent; referenced hashes verified; only completed levels certified; final package declares unvalidated functions and human limits
failure_states: missing evidence, restricted leakage, generic source list called completed paper, unreviewed science
